item.title: Blog: A Skill I Am Learning
item.prompt_text: You write a blog for English learners. Write a post about a new skill you have started learning recently, for example coding, cooking, driving or playing the dutar. Tell your readers about your experience.
item.target_grammar: present perfect (have learned, have been practising) vs past simple
item.target_structure: title + the skill and why I started + how I learn + a difficulty + progress + advice for readers

checklist.point: Say what the skill is and why you started
Explain how you are learning it
Describe a difficulty and how you dealt with it
Say what progress you have made so far
Give advice or ask your readers a question
